in_marathi.name: Taruni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taruni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Taruni is a Sanskrit and Hindu name derived from the word ‘Taru’ meaning 'star' and ‘Ni’ meaning ‘joy’ or ‘new’. The name is believed to bring joy and vitality to the one it is bestowed upon.
